mode: interactive TUI, --permission-mode default, isolated config, loopback fixture model returning AskUserQuestion and Bash tool_use blocks in one assistant message
purpose: Settle ANALYSIS-100: whether a question and a permission are pending together and whether each dialog sends its own permission_prompt.
note: Field names and relative timing are actual. Session IDs, paths, prompts and tool payloads are omitted; tool_use_ids are fixture values. The user answered the question and approved Bash in the probe window.
findings: Claude runs the two tool calls sequentially in the main agent: the Bash PreToolUse and PermissionRequest arrive only after PostToolUse(AskUserQuestion). The question and the Bash permission were never pending together.
The single permission_prompt during the question dialog was the question's own (6.0 s after its PermissionRequest); no Bash wait existed at that time.

Bash was approved 5.7 s after its PermissionRequest, before the documented ~6 s notification delay, so no Bash permission_prompt was emitted. This run therefore does not show a second prompt; Claude's hooks documentation states the notification fires per waiting prompt after ~6 s without typing.

Consequence for 2A.6: re-evaluating a held prompt by elimination when the question resolves would credit the question's own prompt to a later permission. Re-evaluation by elimination is withdrawn; a later human permission relies on its own permission_prompt.
unverified: Parallel question and permission from different agents (main plus subagent) in one session
A Bash permission_prompt in this combined sequence when left unanswered for more than 6 s
